user.title: Gemini Decisions
user.description: Gemini Decisions answers Home Assistant's evaluate tasks with Google's Decisions API. Pick which Gemini API key it should use. Reusing your Google Gemini key means both share one Google quota.

api_key.title: Gemini API key
api_key.description: Paste a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.

reauth_confirm.title: Google rejected the API key
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a working Gemini API key.

reconfigure.title: Change the API key
reconfigure.description: Paste the Gemini API key to use from now on.

error.permission_denied: This key works but can't use the Gemini API. Check that the Generative Language API is enabled for its Google project.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Google. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: Gemini Decisions is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Gemini Decisions is already set up.

init.title: Gemini Decisions options
init.description: Caps stop a runaway automation from running up a bill. Attachments, such as camera snapshots, are off by default: on Google's free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products.

data.max_attachment_mb: Most attachment data per call (MB, after encoding)

error.invalid_model: Use a model name such as gemini-decision-1.

daily_cap_reached.title: Gemini Decisions hit its daily cap
daily_cap_reached.description: Gemini Decisions stopped answering because it reached its cap of {cap} requests today. It starts again at midnight. If this was expected, raise the cap in its options; if not, check which automation is calling ai_task.evaluate so often.
